Resolve reference columns to display values

Source: R/refs.R
grist_resolve_refs.Rd

Grist returns Ref and RefList columns as row IDs of the referenced table, while the Grist interface shows the values of a display column (such as a person's name). grist_resolve_refs() looks up those display values for data you have already read with grist_records().

Each referenced table is fetched once, even if several columns refer to it. For other kinds of joins, see vignette("joining-tables").

Usage

grist_resolve_refs(
  data,
  doc,
  table,
  columns = NULL,
  how = c("add", "replace"),
  suffix = "_display"
)

Arguments

data

A data frame from grist_records() for table. Use convert = "auto" or "basic" so that references are integer IDs.

doc

A grist_doc object, document ID or document URL. See grist_doc().

table

The table data was read from.

columns

Character vector of Ref or RefList column IDs to resolve. If NULL, every reference column of table found in data is resolved.

how

"add" keeps the reference column and adds the display values in a new column next to it. "replace" replaces the IDs with the display values.

suffix

Suffix for the new column names when how = "add".

Value

data with display values for the reference columns. Ref columns resolve to a vector (with NA for empty references) and RefList columns resolve to a list-column of vectors.

See also

Other records: grist_records(), grist_sql()

Examples

if (FALSE) {
doc <- grist_doc("am2iHJ9Amvo7Ve3EE5emtu")

grist_records(doc, "Orders") |>
  grist_resolve_refs(doc, "Orders")

grist_records(doc, "Orders") |>
  grist_resolve_refs(doc, "Orders", columns = "person", how = "replace")
}
